headline: Good readiness despite short sleep; run 5 km easy only
summary: Garmin recorded 5h 57m sleep (score 75), sleeping heart rate 64 bpm, overnight HRV 41 ms, Body Battery 71 on waking, and Training Readiness 86. Yesterday was a true rest day, matching the prior prescription. Run 5 km easy today at conversational effort, with no strides or quality work; the short sleep is the reason to keep the session capped.

recommendation.title: 5 km easy today
details: Run 5 km easy, capped at 35 minutes, at RPE 2–3 with full-sentence breathing. Keep it flat if practical; no strides, hills, tempo, or pace target.
The cap reflects only 5h 57m sleep. Training Readiness 86, Body Battery 71 at wake, and very low acute load support easy aerobic movement, not quality work.
Take the rest day planned for tomorrow, then reassess the next overnight record before the planned 6 km easy run.
recommendation.alternative: If you feel unusually fatigued, sleepier than expected, or otherwise not normal during the warm-up, replace the run with 20–30 minutes of easy walking or complete rest.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.
